title: DRC Conflict Tracker Update — Aug 29, 2026
summary: President Tshisekedi launched a three-month national dialogue on Aug 28 that explicitly excludes AFC/M23, days after Kinshasa suspended academic activity at 11 public universities in M23-held Goma and Bukavu — moves running on a track separate from the Aug 22 DRC-M23 joint statement agreeing a sequenced Doha roadmap. The ICJ set a 2027-2028 filing timetable for DRC's case against Rwanda, pushing any judgment to 2029 or later. DRC's Ebola outbreak reached 5,794 confirmed cases and 2,786 deaths as of the Aug 27 report, alongside a new frontline-worker vaccination campaign launched in Kisangani. Backfilled events for the Aug 22, 27 and 28 gap days; updated timeline, KPIs, casualties, claims and political sections accordingly.

title: DRC Conflict Tracker Update — Aug 27, 2026
summary: DRC and Angola signed a 30-year, $1.8 billion concession granting Portugal's Mota-Engil the rehabilitation and operation of the Dilolo-Sakania railway linking the Katanga copperbelt to Angola's Lobito port, a major milestone for the US-backed minerals corridor. Separately, Beni civil society leader Patrick Katsuva was shot dead overnight near Mambango, steps from security force positions, sparking brief protests. The DRC's Ebola outbreak reached 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths as of the Aug 26 WHO report. Events, KPIs, casualties and economic data were updated; other sections were reviewed and found current, with no confirmed new events in the Aug 20-22 gap window beyond what was already captured in the timeline.

title: DRC Conflict Tracker Update — Aug 24, 2026
summary: The first EJVM+ ceasefire verification mission was due in Minembwe, South Kivu, on Aug 24, testing the Doha-process monitoring mechanism agreed in Geneva two days earlier. Separately, civil society in North Kivu's Bapere sector (Lubero territory) reported that ADF/ISCAP fighters have killed more than 2,400 civilians since mid-2024, with the Manguredjipa axis among the hardest-hit areas, even as joint FARDC-UPDF operations and Wazalendo engagement brought some recent calm. Timeline, map points and casualties were updated to reflect the new toll; other sections were reviewed but unchanged.

title: DRC Conflict Tracker Update — Aug 23, 2026
summary: DRC and M23 agreed a Geneva-brokered roadmap for Doha peace talks on Aug 22, with the first EJVM+ ceasefire verification mission set for Aug 24 in Minembwe. Fighting nonetheless widened: drone strikes hit the Mwalu Hotel in Fizi and a rebel-linked drone was intercepted near Runyengo, M23-allied Twirwaneho clashed with pro-government forces in the Minembwe highlands, M23 recaptured Kalehe's Ziralo grouping and pushed further into Masisi, and Walungu territory saw its first clashes since May 2026. KPIs, timeline, map points/lines, casualties, claims and assets were updated to reflect these developments.
